warnings: The only season shown is Spring/Summer 2026, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information has been posted yet.
This is a town Parks & Recreation landing page, not a camp page. All program details (camps, dates, prices, ages) are in a linked PDF program guide that was not part of the source.

The phone number and address on the page (171 Bridge Street, White River Junction, VT 05001) belong to Hartford Town Hall. They are not necessarily where programs take place, so the street address was left blank.
It is not clear whether any summer day camp is offered. The page only lists general spring/summer programs.
